verdict.rationale: There is no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting. The closest evidence is that Helicone is open-source and self-hostable (e.g. via Docker Compose), which could let users keep request data off Helicone's cloud. That only indirectly addresses the story. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out control or environment flag, documentation of what usage data the self-hosted or cloud product reports back to Helicone, and independent confirmation that self-hosted deployments send no telemetry.
